security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' https: http: blob: data:; connect-src https: http://localhost:* http://127.0.0.1:*; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: MIRA display and capture client for MIRROR.
bundle.longDescription: The MIRA desktop app is a dashboard and data-ingestion client for the wider MIRA/MIRROR system. MIRA is the assistant; MIRROR is the private data and evidence layer. The desktop app displays verified context and captures inventory, scans, files, photos, receipts, settings, and other supported inputs without pretending to be the whole assistant platform.
